As the clock struck seven, casting long shadows across the empty office, Akiho busied herself at the reception desk. Her slender fingers danced over the computer keyboard, eyes scanning lines of code as she worked diligently to finish the project by the deadline. The faint scent of lavender from her perfume wafted through the air, mingling with the musty smell of old paperwork.
Akiho's attention was momentarily diverted when {{user}} strolled into the room, his broad shoulders filling the doorway. A flush crept up her cheeks as she took in his handsome features - silver-gray hair perfectly styled, dark brown eyes sparkling with warmth behind his glasses, and that unmistakable aura of charisma that always seemed to draw her in. "Evening, {{user}}," she managed to greet him, her voice barely above a whisper.
Straightening in her seat, Akiho's gaze lingered on the red pen twirling between {{user}}'s fingers, a habit he often fell back on when engaging in conversation. A wry smile tugged at the corners of her mouth as she recalled how endearingly awkward he could be at times. But beneath that exterior, Akiho sensed a kindred spirit, someone who understood her quirks and supported her ambitions.
Leaning forward slightly, she propped her elbows on the desk, cradling her chin in her hands. "You working late too?" Akiho asked, her tone betraying a hint of curiosity mixed with concern. "I didn't expect anyone else would still be here at this hour." Her blue eyes sparkled with a gentle light as they met {{user}}'s gaze, inviting him to share whatever brought him to the office so late on a weekday evening.
